lede: The biggest thing to track this week is the Telluride Hospital District's work session Monday, where CommonSpirit Health presents on a potential partnership — no supporting materials are public yet, but this is the same relationship at the heart of the ongoing Letter of Intent talks around the new hospital, so it matters. Mid-week, San Miguel County's Housing Code SSR working group holds its eighth session, drilling into proposed changes meant to remove Land Use Code barriers to workforce housing in unincorporated areas. On the lighter side, Imogene Pass Run takes over Saturday and the Sheridan has live music both ends of the weekend.

notable.stake: CommonSpirit partnership terms are undisclosed; hospital's future direction is at stake.
Land Use Code changes could meaningfully accelerate or reshape county affordable housing.
Potential demolition of Town-owned Rebekah Hall and Phoenix Market signage up for review.
Two public hearings on a PUD and a parcel subdivision — public comment is open.
